calls.reason: The claim says no AI startup is improving margins. TechCrunch's sourced report says Cursor went from negative to slightly positive gross margins after November 2025, and Sacra estimates Replit rose from -14% to 23% in 2025.
Anthropic's Code Review post shows humans still approve code, but nothing in the packet shows deliberate flattery by design. The claim is largely evaluative rhetoric.
The only evidence is a reported 70% OpenAI compute margin across all paid products. There are no subscription-specific figures for either company, and none for Anthropic.
This forecast has no deadline. The packet shows only Anthropic bundling API credits into some plans, with no subscriber-to-API conversion data.
The S-1 shows 2023–2025 revenue of about $5.01B, matching 'exceeding $5B'. Q4 2025 revenue roughly matches the December run-rate, and the S-1 defines run-rate as an ordinary annualization.
Klarna's savings and METR's mixed productivity studies don't test whether value holds at 3–10x prices. The claim is broad and largely evaluative.
